description: Rebuild the ALIAS editor on the shared component: implement the shared render surface (render_ispf_table), make AliasEditorState an IspfTableHost (columns Act/CE/Command/Alias/Parameters/Description; set I/D/C/SORT; sortable Alias+Command; filter CE+Root; cascading CE->Root dropdowns preserved; Description editable cell), delegate alias_editor_panel/render.rs to it, retire the bespoke line-command flow in favour of the shared pass, add the manual SORT command and auto-sort-on-save in write_override_rows (both via the one alias_sort_key), add the Description column to the ScreenProvider table, and keep the full-shell first-Tab egui_kittest test green. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001.
steps: READ FIRST: context.json, this file, FEAT-001.json (and its findings), docs/specs/ispf-table-editor/design.md, docs/specs/command-configurator/requirements.md Req 7 (7.1-7.10 incl. 7.5a), and the files alias_editor_panel/{render,rows,filter,state,mod}.rs, shell/{alias_editor,alias_editor_line_commands,render_body,render,screen_providers_tables}.rs, shell/tests_{focus,editor_snapshot_tables,alias_editor}.rs.

Implement crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/render.rs: render_ispf_table<H: IspfTableHost>(ui, host, &mut TableEditorState) -> TableAction. Draw: a `Command ===>` line with the STABLE id the Alias editor already uses ("alias_editor_command_line"); a header row from host.columns(); a filter row whose FIRST focusable control's fresh egui::Id is returned so the host can report it as InteriorFocus first/last (the Alias filter CE combo id "alias_filter_ce"); scrolling data rows each with an Act cell + host.render_cell in visual Tab order; a scrollbar when rows exceed the area; and the always-present scratch row when the backing list is empty (Req 4.6). On Enter apply pending line commands first then interpret the verb; return focus to the command line after a structural change. Split into a render_rows.rs sibling if render.rs would exceed 400 non-test lines.

Add `impl crate::shell::ispf_table_editor::IspfTableHost for AliasEditorState` (a new crates/ff-desktop/src/alias_editor_panel/host.rs if render.rs is near the limit): columns Act, CE, Command(canonical), Alias(surface), Parameters(command_template), Description (Req 7.2 order); line_command_set = I,D,C,SORT (M NOT enabled, Req 7.4; R optional as single-row copy); sortable = Alias + Command; filter on CE+Root only (reuse filter.rs::displayed_indices through filter_matches); render_cell draws the existing cascading CE->Root dropdowns (rows.rs render_ce_combo/render_root_combo + revalidate_root_for_env), the surface/template text fields, and a NEW Description text field with id ("alias_description", backing); blank_row = AliasRowEdit::default(); clone_row clones field values with act cleared.

Rewrite crates/ff-desktop/src/alias_editor_panel/render.rs render() to delegate to render_ispf_table, preserving the WorkspaceContext impl and reporting the filter CE dropdown as the first/last interior control. Keep the existing stable ids EXACTLY: command line "alias_editor_command_line", filter CE combo "alias_filter_ce", per-row ("alias_act"|"alias_ce"|"alias_root"|"alias_surface"|"alias_template"|"alias_description", backing). Do not move them -- tests_focus.rs depends on them.

Retire the bespoke flow in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/alias_editor_line_commands.rs: make apply_pending_line_commands delegate to the shared apply pass over self.alias_editor_panel.rows through the Alias host (keep the function as a thin adapter so existing callers/tests resolve); add a SORT arm to apply_alias_command_line that runs the shared sort over the working rows using alias_sort_key; keep FILTER/RESET panel-local; SAVE/CANCEL/END/REFRESH still fall through to dispatch_command_string (unchanged seam).

Add auto-sort-on-save (Req 7.5a) in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/alias_editor.rs::write_override_rows: after grouping each environment's Vec<UserAliasRowToml>, sort it by alias_sort_key(surface, canonical) (the SAME helper the manual SORT uses) immediately before serialise_user_aliases, so every SAVE/END writes sorted order. TDD: a test that write_override_rows writes rows in uppercased-surface order, and that manual SORT produces the same order.

Update crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/screen_providers_tables.rs::alias_table(): add a "Description" header and r.description.clone() value in the Req 7.2 order [Act, CE, Command, Alias, Parameters, Description]. Update crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_editor_snapshot_tables.rs::alias_screen_model_populates_table_with_real_saved_row to expect the Description column.

Write/extend tests: TDD a Description round-trip (save then reload yields the same description) in tests_alias_editor.rs; a C+A copy end-to-end through apply_alias_editor_action; a bare edit does not persist and SAVE applies the pending batch then persists once (extend command_line_applies_line_commands_before_primary_command). Confirm full_shell_alias_editor_first_tab_focuses_first_interior and full_shell_alias_editor_empty_store_i_insert_shows_editable_row in tests_focus.rs still pass against the shared surface.

Re-verify the TabKind::AliasEditor dispatch arm in shell/render_body.rs still compiles unchanged (mem::take -> render_workspace_context -> put back -> apply_alias_editor_action). Keep every new/changed .rs file <=400 non-test lines; split tests before ~200 lines. ASCII-only. STOP before merge.
acceptance_criteria: The Alias editor renders through the shared render_ispf_table component (not a bespoke surface) with columns Act, CE, Command, Alias, Parameters, Description in that order, and the cascading CE->Root dropdowns preserved per row and in the filter row.
Enabled line commands are I/D/C + SORT (no Move); C+A/B copy works; a bare edit/line-command/sort never persists (only a commit verb reaches editable_persist).
The Description column is editable and PERSISTS: a saved description reloads unchanged (round-trip test passes).

Manual `SORT` and auto-sort-on-save produce the SAME ordering (uppercased surface asc, canonical tie-break, per environment); every SAVE/END writes the on-disk file in that sorted order; the ordering is a no-op for already-sorted input and changes no field value.
The ScreenProvider alias_table exposes [Act, CE, Command, Alias, Parameters, Description] and its snapshot test passes.

The full-shell first-Tab egui_kittest test (filter CE dropdown as first interior, no phantom stop) and the empty-store I-insert test still pass; the WorkspaceContext/InteriorFocus single-latch-path, CR-CH-071 save seam, dispatch front door, navigation, descriptor, and resolver are all unchanged.
ff-desktop compiles clean, is clippy-clean (-D warnings) and fmt-clean; the scoped new/updated tests pass. Every touched/new .rs file is <=400 non-test lines; ASCII-only. No merge.
verification: cargo check -p ff-desktop --manifest-path c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/group-b-alias/Cargo.toml  (read the proxy result file; retry on build-dir file lock)
